newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian ambassador among hostages in Peru.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian ambassador among hostages in Peru.

text.p: Bulgaria said on Wednesday its ambassador to Peru was among 200 hostages held by armed guerrillas at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima.

State radio said the foreign ministry had sent a note to the Peruvian embassy in Sofia expressing concern about the fate of the hostages and saying it hoped the Peruvian authorities would do everything possible to prevent bloodshed.
Ambassador Dimitar Stanoev was among the hostages help by the leftist Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MTRA) since Tuesday night.
The Bulgarian foreign ministry said it had contacted other countries' foreign ministries seeking their help, and was in constant contact with the Peruvian embassy.
